title: Chef Hoppie Narrates His First Day In The Life Meal Prepping For Dak Prescott, CeeDee Lamb, Terron Armstead, And Jeffery Simmons
htmlContent:
We have a new section on the platform Call The Day in the Life of Chef Hoppie.

Y'all have been begging for a day in the life of Chef Hoppie, so here we go. Let's get to it.

First, I had to do meal prep for quarterback of the Dallas Cowboys Dak Prescott and defensive tackle for the Tennessee Titans Jeff Simmons.

Then I had to get my boy Terron Armstead, who is the offensive tackle for the Miami Dolphins.

Now, lets go we about to hop on the flight. Let's get to it first class. Now, my boy CeeDee [Lamb] wide receiver for the Dallas Cowboys is in Houston training, so you know I had to pull up on him. Let's go, touchdown in H-Town. Let's get to it.

Hmmm little breakfast... Big breakfast lets get to it yeah... You see me! Now, who do you know got seafood boiled for meal prep? Now that we stocked the fridge up it's time to go. Look how he got me living. Let's go! Man this dude here... Take off let's go. Had to pick up my dog... Hey!

Now, we back at my boy Terron Armstead's [house]. This is less than 24 hours, but we are rocking. Let's get to it. Team Chef Hoppie was going crazy!
